source_qualification.disposition: Retain a source-specific randomized human-function qualification with unresolved HMB chemistry and comparative analysis. Separate independent review is required before any proposal. No automatic identity join or admission.

independent_review.role_disclosure: Independent of the transplant producer packet, with task context; not blind. I previously authored a separate HMB bed-rest qualification. That prior source is not new transplant evidence.
independent_review.source_first_order: Original main scientific text, native tables/figures and complete current registry/protocol narrative were read and findings frozen before producer qualification was opened.
post_source_first_comparison_scope: Fresh relevant live HMB identity fields

findings.comparative_function: The qualification correctly retains actual grip, 6MWT and TUG measurement while identifying the absence of a reported postbaseline between-treatment estimate, CI, P value, baseline-adjusted contrast or treatment-by-time test. HMB within-arm improvement is not converted into controlled efficacy. Equal final grip means are not converted into a null.
findings.primary_endpoint: Current registry explicitly makes FFMI primary; the paper describes minor nonsignificant FFMI changes while emphasizing ASMI. This does not establish comparative primary efficacy or permit substituting ASMI.
findings.analysis_and_missingness: 22 enrolled (12 HMB/10 control), one control sepsis death, 21 T12 completers (12/9). The packet retains the death, survivor-only analysis, lack of ITT/sensitivity and baseline imbalance.
findings.preparation_identity: 3 g/day nominal HMB in juice for 12 weeks versus juice only is reported. Salt, brand, supplier, calcium and batch chemistry remain unknown; no automatic calcium-HMB alias join or inheritance of Kyowa/TSI identity.
findings.protocol_report_conflicts: Registry 24-person power plan versus arbitrary 22-person paper, delayed registration, diet target, time origin, missing six-month outcomes and unclear exact longitudinal analysis are preserved.
findings.reporting_conflicts: Native table/text ASMI/grip thresholds, FMI arm-value mismatch, sarcopenia-count definition uncertainty and qualitative ASMI plot concern remain unresolved without data repair.
findings.safety: No HMB-attributed side effects or discontinuation is reported, with self-report adherence and quantitative drug/lab data absent. Control death and lack of complete event counts remain explicit; no safety equivalence or child safety claim.
findings.durability_and_mechanism: Later post-course observations are acknowledged without claiming verified cessation or durable causal benefit. Mechanism figure is background, not trial evidence for renewal, BUBR1 or chromosome fidelity.
findings.reading_and_access: Full main and current registry narrative support the declared scope; no supplement element in XML and bounded missing history/SAP claims are not overstated. Hidden duplicate PDF text is not relied on over visible tables.
findings.current_identity: Read-only current check at clean52de81f/280 confirms existing exact calcium-HMB identity and absent transplant PMID; earlier source-stage contexts remain historical.

remaining_limits: Comparative treatment effects remain unreported, not null
Chemical form and actual product identity unresolved
Historical registry and locked protocol/SAP unavailable

independent_review.conclusion: Accept the bounded source-specific qualification with unresolved chemistry and comparative efficacy. This is not admission, an exact calcium-HMB join, or nominee promotion.

identity_relation: The source reports HMB, but neither main nor registry identifies salt, product, supplier or batch; do not alias to calcium-HMB or other HMB preparations.
ledger_disposition: Retain source-specific measurement and limitations; no controlled benefit or MVA/BUB1B efficacy is established.
